title: Eliminate Duplicates

entrypoints.name: compress
entrypoints.semantics: Return the first element of every maximal non-empty contiguous run of values equal under ordinary OCaml polymorphic structural equality (=), preserving the runs' left-to-right order. Values equal but separated by a different value are retained as distinct output elements.

trusted_primitive_declarations.role: Generic equality test used only as a component; it is not the final algorithm.

excluded_interfaces: No seed, randomness, option, result, exception-wrapper, mutable-state, stream, or string-specific API is introduced.
float_note: Run boundaries follow OCaml (=): nan is not equal to nan; 0.0 is equal to -0.0.
comparison_note: As with OCaml (=), comparing function-containing values may raise Invalid_argument; this benchmark preserves rather than masks that language behavior.
